eMudScan checks whether Windows and the software installed on your PC still trust the eight eMudhra intermediate CA certificates compromised in October 2026, and tells you what to do for each one.

**Download `eMudScan.exe` below and run it:** nothing to install, no administrator rights needed. It is not code-signed yet, so Windows SmartScreen may say it is unrecognised: choose *More info*, then *Run anyway*.
